description: Sign frozen Hedera transaction bytes with a private key. Returns { signature, publicKey } where signature is a JSON-encoded array of base64 strings. Pure local operation — no network calls. Use after prepare_payment to sign the payment transaction.

privateKey.description: Private key (DER-encoded hex like 302e... or 0x-prefixed ECDSA hex)

txBytes.description: Base64-encoded frozen transaction bytes from prepare_payment

name: sign_transaction
